reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in combining temporal causal discovery with LLM-enhanced news encoding. The temporal causal graph G encodes directional influences between stocks over lags, enabling a structured representation of interdependencies. This is modeled via a Functional Causal Model (FCM) where y_T^i depends additively on its parents in G, plus Gaussian noise. The novelty arises from treating causal discovery as a variational inference problem over G, using a product of Bernoulli distributions with learnable logits. These logits are coupled across lags via MLPs, allowing for temporal consistency. Meanwhile, the LLM-based encoder transforms raw news into structured 5-dimensional embeddings, capturing relevance, sentiment, and impact. These features are then aggregated through shared networks in the FCM. The system avoids heavy FCM/ELBO machinery by focusing on efficient variational approximations and modular design. Failure modes include poor LLM understanding of financial language or insufficient temporal resolution in G.
